name: Laboratory Drudge
oracle_text: At the beginning of each end step, draw a card if you've cast a spell from a graveyard or activated an ability of a card in a graveyard this turn.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of each end step, draw a card if you've cast a spell from a graveyard or activated an ability of a card in a graveyard this turn.

needs.what: a per-player turn-ledger value counting spells a player cast from a graveyard this turn (any graveyard, flashback/escape/retrace/graveyard_cast included) plus activated abilities of cards in a graveyard (unearth, embalm, scavenge, cycling-from-graveyard-style abilities) that player activated this turn -- e.g. {"graveyard_plays_this_turn": "you"} compared > 0, used as the end_step trigger's intervening-if condition
needs.why_existing_wont_do: spells_cast_this_turn counts casts and its filter matches only printed characteristics, not the zone the spell was cast from; cast_from_graveyard is a condition about the source spell itself, not about the turn's other casts; cards_from_graveyard_this_turn counts every card leaving a graveyard (reanimation, exile) and no activation; no ledger records activations from a graveyard at all. An ability_activated/spell_cast trigger setting a turn flag would miss everything done before the Drudge entered, which the 'this turn' ledger must count
